description: Owner is asked only once (saved locally, later runs skip the prompt; --email/--password still changes it), and the starter is now a real x5agent command on PATH (no ./, no subcommand, works from anywhere) that serves the console directly with no update check.
features: install.py asks email/password only on first run — later runs print the saved owner and skip; explicit flags overwrite it.
